A brand new Round joins the mix! Starting from today, the Main Show includes Snowball Survival! Be among the last beans standing to qualify through this chilly challenge. Also added today, over 15 Rounds can now have alternate obstacles and variations. Check out the new Round and some unique twists on old favourites in the Main Show today!

Celebrate the Season with these new costumes available now! Pirouette your way to the podium with the the Sugar Plum pack! Dress your Fall Guy up as the Regal Nutcracker, Ballerina or Rainbow Fairy and dazzle the competition with your Festive get-up!
Sugar Plum Costume Pack Out Now!
The Blunderdome has gotten a wintry makeover with all new Rounds and heaps of fresh features for those chilly beans!
Our updated Crown Ranks bring a whole new level of exclusive rewards for the most competitive players. Don't forget to keep it stylish, we've got more costumes coming your way than ever before!

Future Fashion Costume Pack - Out Now!

Kickstart your Season 4 look with music inspired looks fit for the future!\n\nChoose which act to headline and add The Diva Project, Fresh & Hip and Punk Rock Princess themed costumes to your collection with the Season 4 Costume pack! The future is now, so dress the part!

The futuristic Fall Guys Season 4 is upon us! Along with a host of futuristic Costumes, Cosmetics and Rounds, the new Season introduces a number of cool new features! \nDaily Challenges offer frequent new objectives for rewards! Squad Shows is a whole new mode and a way to play alongside your friends, seeking victory as a team!  \nAll this and more awaits in this new Season update!
There's always time for slime! Survive 3 Rounds of Slime Climb in this show, and the 4th will give you a shot at the crown! It's a long way to the top with slime all the way down!

The Feature Complete build is a major step forward from Closed Beta, containing a much larger pool of exciting rounds and a raft of new features. You can look forward to: 

 •16 unique rounds, curated by our ‘Director’ 
•Online Parties - go through a Show with up to 3 other players in your party!
 •Season rewards and a Store where you can purchase items with currency earned through competing,
•Loads of customization options!  

 Enjoy Fall Guys Feature Complete!
You’re about to star in the greatest gameshow ever created, so let’s take a quick look at how things will play out… and the prizes you can win!

Hit “Play” to enter into a Show. You’ll need to race, chase and outwit 59 other contestants across a random selection of Rounds until YOU are crowned the winner!\n\nGet eliminated? Try again - the cameras are always rolling!

Compete in Shows to earn Kudos and win them to collect Crowns - you can cash these in for cool prizes to dress up your Fall Guy. Plus, you can unlock special rewards every Season by playing and building up your Fame level!
As well as jumping, diving and grabbing you can move with {action=Move} and adjust the camera with {action=Camera}
